# ProxyView

> ProxyView (proxyview.net) is an independent proxy review and comparison site. We publish provider comparisons, practical guides, and research summaries covering proxy types, anti-detect browsers, web scraping, IP access issues, and account management. We are not a proxy provider and do not sell proxies.

What we cover:
- Proxy provider comparisons for specific use cases, including Reddit, Telegram, web scraping, and research.
- Explainers on residential, datacenter, ISP, and mobile proxies.
- Practical guides to proxy testing, connection troubleshooting, and account management.
- Analysis of published research on web scraping access, data quality, and costs.
- An IP checker and a glossary of proxy and anti-detect terminology.

Editorial approach: Provider comparisons draw on published product information, pricing, and official documentation. Research articles analyze cited sources. Provider specifications and third-party findings are not original ProxyView test results. Some links may be affiliate links.

Contact: hello@proxyview.net

## Comparisons

- [Best Facebook proxies for agencies and media buyers](https://proxyview.net/blog/best-facebook-proxies-for-agencies-and-media-buyers): Comparison of published pricing, session controls, and routing options for agency Facebook ad management and QA workflows.
- [Best Reddit proxies in 2026: 6 providers compared](https://proxyview.net/blog/best-reddit-proxies-providers-compared): Comparison of published product features, entry costs, IP persistence, and session options for Reddit use cases.
- [Best Telegram proxies: providers, pricing, and setup compared](https://proxyview.net/blog/best-telegram-proxies-providers-pricing-and-setup-compared): Comparison of published pricing, traffic allowances, and connection options, with SOCKS5 and MTProto setup guidance.
- [Residential vs datacenter proxies](https://proxyview.net/blog/residential-vs-datacenter-proxies): Differences in IP origin, pricing, speed, detection considerations, and suitability for different tasks.

## Guides

- [Proxy types explained: residential, datacenter, ISP, and mobile](https://proxyview.net/blog/proxy-types-explained): How the four proxy types work and which connection characteristics matter when choosing one.
- [What is a proxy used for? 8 real-world use cases](https://proxyview.net/blog/what-is-the-use-case-of-a-proxy): Proxy applications in web scraping, ad verification, price monitoring, SEO, account management, and security testing.
- [How to test if your proxy is working](https://proxyview.net/blog/how-to-test-if-your-proxy-is-working): Checks for the visible IP address, location, target-site access, latency, and rotation behavior.
- [How to get around an IP ban](https://proxyview.net/blog/how-to-get-around-an-ip-ban): Troubleshooting IP-related access restrictions, distinguishing connection and account problems, and reviewing recovery options.
- [What is web scraping? A practical guide for 2026](https://proxyview.net/blog/what-is-web-scraping): An introduction to fetching pages, extracting data, scraping tools, and the role of proxies.
- [How can you have multiple Reddit accounts? Rules and setup](https://proxyview.net/blog/how-can-you-have-multiple-reddit-accounts): Creating and switching between Reddit accounts, understanding prohibited uses, and responding to account restrictions.
- [Telegram Web: how to log in and what you can do from a browser](https://proxyview.net/blog/web-telegram-login-and-features): Browser login methods, messaging features, session management, and account security.

## Research

- [Web scraping challenges: access, data quality, and costs](https://proxyview.net/blog/full-research-on-web-scraping-challenges-access-data-quality-and-costs): Analysis of published research and platform documentation on access failures, data quality, API limitations, and collection costs.
